title: Complete quadratic linear prefix bit
statement: For a Boolean vector $w \\colon \\mathrm{Fin}(n) \\to \\{\\mathrm{false},\\mathrm{true}\\}$ and a natural number $k$, define its linear prefix bit to be the sum in $\\mathbb{F}_2$ of the encoded values $w_i$ over all coordinates $i<k$.
caveat: The encoding of Boolean values into $\\mathbb{F}_2$ is not defined in the supplied payload.
